llm.summary: The skill is a coherent inbound-lead form, but it lets unauthenticated website submissions update shared sales contact records and post submitted personal data to Slack.

dimensions.detail: LinkedIn company enrichment, Slack posting, and GTM model writes are proportionate for inbound qualification. The Slack/data privacy handling is disclosed in the skill and references, but the sample rendered form itself does not include a visible disclosure near submission.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is through documented Cargo CDK cookbook commands and npm package installation for Cargo/form SDK dependencies. The skill instructs planning and review before deployment and requires explicit approval for cargo-ai cdk deploy.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions disclose the Slack posting, company enrichment, public form origin allowlist, spam controls, privacy-review requirement, and explicit deploy approval. Scope is mostly clear, but runtime mutation is controlled by public submissions rather than authenticated workspace users.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The deployed workflow persists account and contact data in shared GTM models and records marketing_consent as a mutable contact field. There is no hidden system persistence, backdoor, scheduled task, or privilege escalation, but the business-data persistence is high impact because public submissions can update canonical records.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose matches the implementation: qualify demo requests, enrich the company, write GTM account/contact records, post to Slack, and return a booking result. The concern is that the public form directly upserts shared business/contact records keyed only by submitted email, so an external submitter can overwrite existing contact fields without email ownership verification or staging.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing or deploying. This skill is not deceptive, but deploy it only if you are comfortable with a public website form updating shared GTM records and posting submissions to Slack. For production, consider staging submissions, verifying email ownership before updating existing contacts or consent fields, limiting Slack payloads, and adding clear privacy notice near the form plus a reviewed privacy-policy section.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced artifacts, including evals/contract.mjs and infra/tools/inbound-form.ts, are present in the workspace and were inspected; the partial-inspection signal does not indicate evasion in this artifact set.
[P9] expected: The long whitespace runs are table alignment in SKILL.md, not hidden off-screen instructions or prompt-injection content.
[SQP-2] expected: Collection of name, work email, message, page/UTM data, and Slack sharing is purpose-aligned and disclosed in the skill/reference instructions, including a required privacy page section; however, users should ensure the live form provides adequate notice.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is supported by artifact evidence: infra/tools/inbound-form.ts upserts gtm_contacts by submitted email from a public form and can overwrite existing shared contact fields without verifying the submitter controls that email.
